experiment: P4a heterogeneous MLCNN classification plus IQ-Grouped parameter route five-seed extension
research_question: Does the heterogeneous task route retain its parameter advantage over the near-parameter-matched shared MLCNN-global baseline on two additional optimization seeds without an unacceptable classification cost?

fairness_control.parameter_count_note: The frozen audit measured 12.807M parameters for MLCNN-global and 12.891M for the heterogeneous route, a 0.66 percent difference.
fairness_control.compute_note: The route has about 11.12 percent more MACs; report this cost and do not call the comparison exactly FLOP-matched.

stop_rule: Do not change architecture, loss, schedule, checkpoint rule, thresholds or gates after viewing seeds 2044 or 2045. If either new seed misses a critical gate, retain the three-seed result as development evidence only and do not claim five-seed robustness.
evidence_boundary: This extension tests optimization-seed robustness on an already used within-root confirmation split. It is not fresh-identity confirmation, parameter OOD, long-tail, composition-disjoint or locked-test evidence.
